CLINICAL TRANSLATION: The primary endpoint (HbA1c change at Week 24) was met for both saxagliptin doses. The enrolled population (T2DM inadequately controlled on TZD) is appropriate for the mechanism — DPP-4 inhibition adds complementary incretin-mediated insulin secretion to TZD-mediated insulin sensitization. 5. CONFOUNDERS: No major confounders identified. Safety was acceptable with SAEs infrequent and distributed across arms. No dose-limiting toxicity.
